adminReports.title: Competition reports
adminReports.lead: Participation and fee totals for each competition your roles cover.
adminReports.downloadHint: The CSV contains aggregate totals only, not participant details.
adminReports.metricsTitle: Participation by route and age group
adminReports.metricsHint: Registrations are confirmed registrations; entries reached submission; shortlisted counts current school picks; verified entries have passed FOA verification; certificates are currently issued, whether or not their PDFs are ready.
adminReports.notApplicable: — means not applicable: the individual route has no school shortlist.
adminReports.feesHint: Accepted fee payments and completed fee refunds; duplicate payment returns are not fee refunds. Pending payments and refunds are excluded.
adminReports.noAgeGroups: No age groups are set for this competition.
